name: One-arm pull-up
goal: 1 strict one-arm pull-up on each arm

stages.name: Pull-up base
stages.work: Strict pull-ups, scapular pulls, dead hangs, short one-arm hangs

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
exercises.cue: Arms straight. Pull the shoulder blades down; the elbows do not bend.

exercises.name: Strict pull-up
exercises.cue: Overhand, chin clearly over the bar, full lockout at the bottom.

exercises.name: One-arm hang
exercises.cue: The other hand takes some weight (on the wrist or a band) if the shoulder complains. Stop at any elbow pain.

stages.name: Weighted
stages.work: Weighted pull-ups ramping to +25 % bodyweight (uses your bodyweight rule)

stages.name: Assisted one-arm
stages.work: One-arm with the other hand on the wrist or a towel/band, assist reducing

stages.name: One-arm negatives
stages.work: 6–8 s lowering, ≤ 4 reps per arm per session

stages.name: One-arm pull-up
stages.work: Partials from 90° to the top, then full attempts
